features.title: Register and identify local DSH runtimes
features.summary: Maintain a bounded host/runtime directory with stable runtime identity, tokenized local URLs, discovered workspaces, and sessions.

configuration.constraints: Optional trimmed identifier of 1 to 64 characters; if supplied it must match the profile name discovered from the environment/argv.

failureModes: Profile mismatch or runtime identity change rejects registration.
Corrupt or unsupported directory data is left intact and writes are refused.

verification.reason: No browser journey exists yet for the identity-profile scenario of "Register and identify local DSH runtimes"; nothing automated verifies it yet.
No browser journey exists yet for the directory-safety scenario of "Register and identify local DSH runtimes"; nothing automated verifies it yet.

features.title: Connect to an SSH-managed runtime
features.summary: Attach through a systemd-managed remote DSH unit, verify pinned identity/capabilities, and avoid implicit agent forwarding or untrusted host-key acceptance.
failureModes: Host-key or identity mismatch rejects attachment.
SSH journal/user service failure does not create a connected runtime.

externalDependencies.boundary: SSH subprocess, remote systemd user service, journal, and host key.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Inject fake SSH argv results and journal output; never connect to a real host or user SSH agent.

verification.reason: No browser journey exists yet for the ssh-connect scenario of "Connect to an SSH-managed runtime"; nothing automated verifies it yet.
No browser journey exists yet for the ssh-identity-profile scenario of "Connect to an SSH-managed runtime"; nothing automated verifies it yet.

features.title: Open workspaces and sessions on the selected runtime
features.summary: List workspaces and sessions per runtime, create sessions, and route workspace opening only to the explicitly selected compatible runtime.
failureModes: A capability or version mismatch disables incompatible actions.
An unknown mutation result after a lost reply is inspected and never automatically replayed.

externalDependencies.boundary: Token-authenticated HTTP/WebSocket RPC to a selected DSH runtime.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Use an injected in-memory gateway transport with synthetic token and runtime identities; no real DSH profile credentials.

verification.reason: No browser journey exists yet for the session-routing scenario of "Open workspaces and sessions on the selected runtime"; nothing automated verifies it yet.
No browser journey exists yet for the uncertain-mutation scenario of "Open workspaces and sessions on the selected runtime"; nothing automated verifies it yet.

features.title: Open and close runtime views safely
features.summary: Open native runtime views in isolated browser origins, enforce bounded expiring leases, and close one or all views without affecting remote runtime data.
failureModes: Popup blocking remains visible and does not claim a view opened.
Lease release failure does not erase or mutate the remote runtime.
